verdict.rationale: Authenticator does support passkey sign-in, but its documentation states that its passkeys are device-bound and never leave the device they were created on. That is the opposite of syncing passkeys across iOS, Android, Windows, Linux and browsers. No evidence shows any cross-ecosystem passkey sync; the cloud backup described covers one-time password codes, not passkeys.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
